# Pull Request

> External code contributions are by invitation only. Before opening a pull request, please read the [Codex contribution guidelines](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/docs/contributing.md). Pull requests that do not follow the repository's contribution policy may be closed without review.

## Summary

<!-- Describe what changed, why it is needed, and the user-visible or technical impact. -->

## Related issue

<!-- Link the bug report, feature request, or discussion this change addresses. If none exists, explain why. -->

## Validation

<!-- List the commands, tests, and checks you ran. Include relevant results and clearly identify anything you could not test. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request is ready for review and is not a draft.
- [ ] The change is focused and follows the repository's contribution guidelines.
- [ ] I updated documentation or comments where the behavior or interfaces changed.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the change, where applicable.
- [ ] I ran the relevant formatting, linting, and test checks, and reported any checks I could not run.
- [ ] I reviewed the final diff and removed unrelated changes.
- [ ] I checked that no credentials, tokens, private data, or other sensitive information are included.
